nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What are the conditions under which BMRA can reproduce the gains of a fully cooperative fishing agreement?
nodes.answer: BMRA can reproduce these fully cooperative gains if adult movement from the fishing patch to the reserve patch is low (40%), and adult movement from the reserve patch to the fishing patch is high (60%), regardless of larval movement.

nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: What is the role of a sole owner in the fully cooperative fishing agreement described in the paper?
nodes.answer: The sole owner has perfect tenure over the entire spatial extent of the resource and simultaneously manages both countries' waters to maximize system-wide profit.
